pages.title: A captured essence
pages.text: “A soul does not always vanish after death. Sometimes it can be held, if you know what to grasp.”$(br2)The Soul Catcher captures creatures and stores them inside the item.$(br2)$(#1C7FA8)Capture:$() right-click a mob.$(br)$(#1C7FA8)Release:$() tap right-click to release it forward.$(br)$(#1C7FA8)Absorb:$() hold right-click for $(thing)5 seconds$(). The creature’s health is transferred to you, and any excess becomes hunger.

pages.title: Capture limits
pages.text: The Soul Catcher cannot capture bosses or creatures that currently have more than $(thing)50 hearts$() of health. Current health counts, so a weakened creature can be caught. It can also act as a lantern: hold Shift and right-click a block to place it. If it contains a creature, it emits light. Break the placed lantern to retrieve it with the creature inside.
